prompt: Your friendship group is planning a day out at an expensive place. You know one friend is quietly struggling for money but would be embarrassed if that became the focus. What is the most inclusive approach?

options.text: Announce in the group chat that your friend cannot afford the plan, so everyone should pick somewhere cheaper
Pay for your friend without asking them and mention your generosity to the group
Leave your friend off the invitation to spare them the embarrassment of saying no
Privately check what budget works for your friend, then suggest a few lower-cost options to the group as your own preference without naming their situation

explanation: Checking privately protects their dignity, and suggesting cheaper options as your own idea keeps them included without making them the reason. Announcing their finances or quietly excluding them both single them out.
